items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: Ed Major who was with Charley Johnson -- they played quite a lot of jazz.

ctx.x: Well, the first time that I ever heard of jazz was after we come back here, let's see -- well, in Atlantic City, we started playing it. Because I opened up with a -- I opened down there and then there were -- Ed Major who was with Charley Johnson -- they played quite a lot of jazz. They played jazz -- it wasn't the livery stable jazz, not Dixieland Jazzband. We had a lot of jazz before that.
But I mean the use of the term, 'jazz'. Was it called, 'jazz'?
